name: Prats de Lluçanès (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the yellow castle of the arms closed in red, between the four white roses of the arms in the corners.
history: The flag was approved on 27 February 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3346 of 13 March 2001; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, light blue, with the yellow castle closed in red of the arms 4/5 of the height at the centre and the four white roses of the arms, of diameter 1/5 of the height, in the corners.

features.role: castle closed in red, 4/5 of the height
door and windows of the castle
four roses in the corners, 1/5 of the height
